statements: The advisory describes workers posing as freelancers based in other countries and offering mobile or web development, IT support, animation, database, online-platform, hardware and firmware work. It identifies VPNs, VPSs, VoIP, encrypted messaging, AI-enabled deepfakes and proxies lending personal information or employment-platform accounts as concealment methods. It recommends reviewing documents for inconsistencies, interviewing through multiple channels, using deepfake-detection strategies, and checking references and credentials.
Evidence class: official national cyber and law-enforcement advisory.
Risk hypothesis from the same advisory: privileged access may be used to insert passive malware or code backdoors; the source does not identify a proved Canadian incident.

sources.support: Evidence class: official national cyber and law-enforcement advisory. Claim support: The advisory describes workers posing as freelancers based in other countries and offering mobile or web development, IT support, animation, database, online-platform, hardware and firmware work. It identifies VPNs, VPSs, VoIP, encrypted messaging, AI-enabled deepfakes and proxies lending personal information or employment-platform accounts as concealment methods. It recommends reviewing documents for inconsistencies, interviewing through multiple channels, using deepfake-detection strategies, and checking references and credentials. Original-language support (fr): L’avis décrit des travailleurs se présentant comme des travailleurs autonomes basés dans d’autres pays et offrant le développement d’applications mobiles ou Web, le soutien des TI, l’animation graphique, les bases de données, les plateformes en ligne, le matériel informatique et les micrologiciels. Pour dissimuler leur identité, ils peuvent utiliser des VPN, des VPS, la voix sur IP, des applications chiffrées, des hypertrucages générés par l’IA et des mandataires qui prêtent leurs renseignements ou comptes de plateforme. L’avis recommande l’examen des incohérences documentaires, des entrevues par plusieurs moyens, la détection des hypertrucages et la vérification des références et des titres de compétence. Attribution boundary: Authoritative French counterpart to NCAO5-CAN-RCMP-2025-07-16-EN; not an independent incident source
